title: NDCG/MRR live sweeps and synthetic-prompt calibration for embeddings->rerank
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Some customers report rank-quality regressions after embedding model updates; current NDCG/MRR telemetry lacks consistent coverage across latency percentiles and low-volume customer prompt sets. We need a reproducible, low-cost evaluation harness that combines customer prompt-set replays with lightweight synthetic candidate generation and live A/B hooks so we can detect regressions and measure trade-offs between latency-optimized kernels and full-precision kernels.

Goal: Build a 'live sweep' pipeline that (1) runs NDCG and MRR measurement across stratified customer prompt sets and synthetic augmentations, (2) tracks metrics per-latency-bucket and per-customer-cohort, (3) exposes a simple canary/AB hook to route a % of production traffic and collect labeled telemetry, and (4) produces calibration artifacts (prompt transformations and synthetic negative/positive candidates) to improve low-resource evaluation fidelity.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end pipeline produces daily NDCG and MRR time series for all active customer prompt sets
Metrics are reported sliced by latency percentiles (p50/p90/p99) and customer cohort (enterprise/mid-market/startup)
A/B hook supports 0.1% to 10% traffic routing and emits stable, labeled events to the eval topic
Synthetic prompt-generator produces candidate pools that increase NDCG sensitivity by >= 10% for low-volume prompt sets in at least two customers
Dashboard + alerting: regression alert when NDCG drops > 3 points for a cohort or when MRR changes by > 5% week-over-week
implementation_plan: Instrument embedding->rerank service to emit unified eval events (request_id, prompt_set_id, candidate_signatures, latency_ms, model_variant)
Build a lightweight synthetic-candidate generator module (configurable templates + noise injection) to expand customer prompt sets for calibration
Create a streaming job (Flink/Kafka Streams prototype) that joins production eval events with synthetic replay and computes incremental NDCG/MRR by slice
Add an AB router flag in the API gateway + SDKs to mirror 0.1-10% traffic to canary model variants and tag events with experiment_id
Wire computed metrics into a Grafana dashboard and create alert rules in PagerDuty for threshold breaches
test_plan: Unit tests for synthetic generator (coverage for template variations, random seed determinism)
Integration test: replay shard that replays stored customer prompt sets and synthetic expansions against baseline and canary models in CI
Load test: validate streaming job throughput at 10x expected eval traffic using a synthetic event producer
Shadow run: deploy AB hook with 0.1% mirrored traffic for two weeks, compare offline NDCG/MRR to live measurements
Post-deploy validation: backfill 14 days of data and run regression detector to ensure alerts fire as expected
rollout: Phase 1 (dev): synthetic generator + unit tests + mock streaming job (owner: Liam) - target: 2026-02-24
Phase 2 (staging): integrate with rerank service, run shadow mirror at 0.1% for internal customers - target: 2026-03-10
Phase 3 (canary): enable AB hook for 1% traffic on a subset of customers with high telemetry fidelity - target: 2026-03-17
Phase 4 (prod): scale to 5-10% and enable alerting and regular reports - target: 2026-03-28
